title: EgoBabyVLM: Benchmarking Cross-Modal Learning from Naturalistic Egocentric Video Data
venueFull: Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS), Evaluations & Datasets Track
summary: Trains vision-language models on data with varying visual-linguistic alignment, including infant head-camera video. Introduces the Machine-DevBench benchmark and the EgoBabyVLM Challenge, and shows that current VLMs fail to exploit the weakly aligned signal in naturalistic egocentric input.
